items.text: to pack a bag (doer: the man)
items.evidence: 0.12-2.38s the man puts apples, bread, a wrapped sandwich and a water bottle into the open bag. P1 box keys are identical to P3, so the red box is drawn under the yellow one; it sits on the man the whole time.

items.text: to lie on the grass (doer: the apple)
items.evidence: An apple falls out at 3.62s and lies on the grass 3.88-5.12s; the P2 box is on it 4.12-5.12s. At 5.38s the box is empty because the apple is gone from the grass (the man is holding it).

items.text: to hold a water bottle (doer: the man)
items.evidence: The man never clearly holds the bottle. At 2.12s his hand is only next to it as it goes into the bag; from 2.88s on he holds the bag by its handles and the bottle sits inside the bag.
items.fix_hint: to hold a bag up / to lift a bag (2.88-4.62s)

items.evidence: On the nouns still the point is on the bag's lower edge, right where the man's legs start, not clearly on the bag's body.
items.fix_hint: move the point onto the bag body, e.g. (0.45,0.50)

items.text: the grass (0.9,0.12)
items.evidence: The point is on the trees and sky at the top right. There is no grass there; the grass is at the bottom of the frame.
items.fix_hint: move the point onto the grass, e.g. (0.85,0.88)

items.text: a water bottle (0.15,0.2)
items.evidence: The point is on the man's left hand/bag handle beside his face; the bottle is in the bag at about (0.6,0.38).
